name: wegmans-mcp
description: Search Wegmans groceries, build your cart and shopping list, order Meals2Go prepared food, and clip digital coupons.
long_description: Gives Claude tools for your Wegmans account: search the grocery catalog (prices, aisles, nutrition — works without login), build the wegmans.com grocery cart (which doubles as your in-store My List, aisle-sorted in the Wegmans app), order Meals2Go prepared food (subs, pizza, bowls), find stores, switch pickup/delivery, and clip Shoppers Club coupons. First use: just ask Claude to set up your Wegmans login — a browser window opens and you sign in with your own account. Sessions are stored only on this computer (~/.wegmans-mcp). Claude never places the final order; you always hit Checkout yourself.

store_id.title: Home store number
store_id.description: Your default Wegmans store number (optional — you can also just ask Claude to find and set your store). Leave empty if unsure.

loyalty_id.title: Shoppers Club number
loyalty_id.description: Optional — auto-detected during login. Only set manually if coupon tools ask for it.
